hooks.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eq 'git[^;&|]*[[:space:]]push[^;&|]*([[:space:]:+/]main([^A-Za-z0-9_.-]|$)|--all|--mirror)'; then echo 'Blocked by project hook: main only changes through a merged pull request (no direct push, no force push, no --all/--mirror). Push a branch and open a PR.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
